# Draft:Imagin (digital banking)

----
}}
imagin (formerly imaginBank) is a Spain based mobile-only digital banking platform owned by the financial institution CaixaBank.
History
imagin was launched on January 14, 2016, when CaixaBank released the initial version under the name imaginBank conceived as the first “mobile-only” bank in Spain.
In 2020, CaixaBank relaunched the service under the shortened brand name imagin, expanding it beyond traditional banking into a broader digital services and lifestyle platform. The relaunch introduced segmented applications aimed at children, teenagers, and young adults, combining financial products with educational and digital content.
The platform, operated by ImaginersGen, S.A. as an agent of CaixaBank, currently has 3.9 million customers, mostly young people. imagin is characterized by its close, approachable language and a communication model adapted to digital generations, dispensing with physical branches and focusing on a fully mobile experience.
The platform also integrates customer support through digital channels and allows users to access CaixaBank’s ATM network for cash withdrawals.
imaginBank was among the first Spanish banks to incorporate customer service chatbots through messaging platforms, including Facebook Messenger.
